input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v2 (V = Qe * tau) by a reduced-speed rise then a full-speed decay, occupants as the CO2 source.

steps.why: Rise: reduced effective flow (0.3 m3/min) so occupants' CO2 climbs from the 2000 ppm start towards an equilibrium of about 2500 ppm, below the 3000 ppm limit.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min); with V about 30 m3 (first guess, stated as such) tau = V/Qe about 30 min, so 35 min is one tau or more; recorded and fitted towards C_eq.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person leaves the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring is lost, or one more person enters the lab

monitoring.reason: The two occupants of the lab breathe the raised CO2 of the volume under test; the hab-b crew is outside the test volume (hatch closed).

expected.rise: At 30 percent (Qe about 0.3 m3/min) with 2 occupants awake (0.76 L/min) the CO2 drifts up slowly from 2000 ppm, about 5 ppm/min at V=30 m3, roughly +50 to +100 ppm in 20 min, towards about 2530 ppm; a flat or falling curve means the source is lower than assumed or the zone is exchanging air.
expected.decay: At full speed the CO2 falls from the step-1 end value towards C_eq of about 760 ppm with tau about 30 min (V about 30 m3, Qe 1 m3/min, plus the scrubber lag of 3.33 min); fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) and V = Qe*tau.
expected.V_lab: Expected within the register's fitted band 10 to 200 m3, first guess 30 m3.
expected.disproof: A tau far from 30 min with a good fit gives another V; a poor single-exponential fit, a CO2 rise in hab-b, or an equilibrium far from 760 ppm shows exchange through the closed hatch or a source that changed (someone entering or leaving), and invalidates the curve.

hypotheses: The lab is one well-mixed zone.

The hatch between lab and hab-b stays closed during both steps; the exchange through the closed hatch is not measured and is not assumed zero (design ventilation 3 m3/min hatch closed is a stated hypothesis to be checked against the hab-b CO2 record).
The two lab occupants stay and keep a constant awake activity (0.38 L/min each, band 0.26 to 0.45); any change invalidates the curve.
Effective flow at full speed is the datasheet's 1 m3/min and scales linearly with speed; the scrubber lag is 3.33 min.

The first guess V=30 m3 is only used to size the durations; at 30 percent tau is about 100 min so the rise phase cannot last one tau within the 60 min bound: it only moves the operating point, and the decay gives V.
The hab-b CO2 (co2-2-v2), the speed commands and their acceptance are recorded every minute along with the lab CO2.
